title: Jannini asks the court to let them exhume Chereze to study the bacteria

tellings.quote: after 30 yearsini is suggesting and requesting authorization from the court.

plain: Thirty years after the 1996 Varginha case in Brazil, in which strange creatures were reported in the town, a doctor named Jannini is said to be asking a court for permission to dig up the body of a man named Chereze, whose death is part of that story, to study the bacteria involved. Ahmed Foratu, who speaks on the show about the case, tells Michels about the request. If the study went ahead, it could test whether contact with the creature had something to do with the death.
